@@ -570,29 +572,44 @@ module Histlog
             # fall through to normal output
           else
             height = options[:height] || 10
-            # Disable preview for paths interactive for a simpler UI
-            sel = Histlog::Utils.fzf_select(display_lines, height, preview: false)
+            # Enable preview for better UX - show just the path name
+            sel = Histlog::Utils.fzf_select(display_lines, height, preview: true)

-            # If the selection was a table-like line, try to extract the path

+              # For plain format, the selection is just the path
+              sel_no_ansi = sel.gsub(/\e\[[\d;]*m/, '')
+              puts sel_no_ansi.strip
             else
+              # For formatted output, extract path from the tab-separated fields
               sel_no_ansi = sel.gsub(/\e\[[\d;]*m/, '')
               # split: index<TAB>visible
               parts = sel_no_ansi.split("\t", 2)
-              if parts.length == 2 && parts[0] =~ /^\d+$/
+              if parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] =~ /^\d+$/
+                # Valid tab-separated format: extract index and get original path
                 sel_idx = parts[0].to_i
-                path_part = originals[sel_idx] || ''
-                puts path_part
+                if sel_idx >= 0 && sel_idx < originals.length
+                  puts originals[sel_idx]
+                else
+                  # Fallback: try to extract path from the visible part
+                  visible_part = parts[1] || ''
+                  path_part = visible_part.split(/\s*│\s*/).last || visible_part
+                  puts path_part.strip
+                end
               else
-                # Fallback: try previous separator extraction
+                # Fallback: try to extract path from the visible part
                 parts2 = sel_no_ansi.split(/\s*│\s*/)
-                path_part = parts2.last ? parts2.last.strip : sel_no_ansi.strip
-                puts path_part
+                if parts2.length >= 2
+                  path_part = parts2.last.strip
+                  puts path_part
+                else
+                  # Last resort: use the whole selection
+                  puts sel_no_ansi.strip
+                end
               end
             end
             return

-            $__histlog_path _on_session
-          )
-        end
+    if test -z "$__histlog_session_id"
+      set -gx __histlog_path "#{histlog_path}"
+      set -gx __histlog_session_id (
+        $__histlog_path _on_session
+      )

-        function __histlog_preexec --on-event fish_preexec
-          set -gx __histlog_command_id (
-            $__histlog_path _on_preexec $argv[1] $__histlog_session_id
-          )
-        end
+    function __histlog_preexec --on-event fish_preexec
+      set -gx __histlog_command_id (
+        $__histlog_path _on_preexec $argv[1] $__histlog_session_id
+      )
+    end
 
-        function __histlog_postcmd --on-event fish_postexec
-          $__histlog_path _on_postcmd $__histlog_command_id $CMD_DURATION $status
-          set --erase __histlog_command_id
-        end
+    function __histlog_postcmd --on-event fish_postexec
+      $__histlog_path _on_postcmd $__histlog_command_id $CMD_DURATION $status
+      set --erase __histlog_command_id
+    end
 
-        # Quick helpers:
-        # hlz  - interactive selection (uses fzf) and cd into selected directory
-        # hlZ  - non-interactive: cd to top result
-        function hlz
-          # Pass all arguments through to histlog paths --interactive and take the
-          # first resulting path (if any) for cd.
-          set -l target (histlog paths --dirs --plain --sort-by exec --interactive $argv)
-          if test -n "$target"
-            cd "$target"
-          end
-        end
+    # Quick helpers:
+    # hlz  - interactive selection (uses fzf) and cd into selected directory
+    # hlZ  - non-interactive: cd to top result
+    function hlz
+      # Pass all arguments through to histlog paths --interactive and take the
+      # first resulting path (if any) for cd.
+      set -l target (histlog paths --dirs --sort-by exec --interactive $argv)
+      if test -n "$target"
+        cd "$target"
+      end
+    end
 
-        function hlZ
-          set -l target (histlog paths --dirs --plain --sort-by exec --limit 1 $argv)
-          if test -n "$target"
-            cd "$target"
-          end
-        end
+    function hlZ
+      set -l target (histlog paths --dirs --plain --sort-by exec --limit 1 $argv)
+      if test -n "$target"
+        cd "$target"
+      end
+    end
 
-        function hlc
-          # Interactive command selection and place into the commandline buffer
-          set -l cmd (histlog commands --context --plain --interactive $argv)
-          if test -n "$cmd"
-            commandline -r "$cmd"
-          end
-        end
+    function hlc
+      # Interactive command selection and place into the commandline buffer
+      set -l cmd (histlog commands --context --interactive $argv)
+      if test -n "$cmd"
+        commandline -r "$cmd"
+      end
+    end
 
 
-        function hlC
-          # Non-interactive: select top command and place into the commandline buffer
-          set -l cmd (histlog commands --context --plain --limit 1 $argv)
-          if test -n "$cmd"
-            commandline -r "$cmd"
-          end
-        end
+    function hlC
+      # Non-interactive: select top command and place into the commandline buffer
+      set -l cmd (histlog commands --context --plain --limit 1 $argv)
+      if test -n "$cmd"
+        commandline -r "$cmd"
+      end
+    end
   FISH
 end
